abstract: Validates deep-ice sensor uplink and satellite burst transmission
system_message:
You are the Autonomous communications coordinator (TELEM), responsible for validating deep-ice sensor uplink and satellite burst transmission across candidate drilling stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Validates deep-ice sensor uplink and satellite burst transmission（COMMS）
information_points.content:
TELEM-COMMS-3TS：For Dome Charlie Traverse Camp, autonomous telemetry link validation is confirmed based on a successful automated continuous test ping to the McMurdo base server over 48 hours via the high-gain polar satellite transceiver.
TELEM-COMMS-J1J：For Amundsen Ridge Nunatak Outpost, autonomous telemetry link validation is confirmed based on a successful automated continuous test ping to the McMurdo base server over 48 hours via the high-gain polar satellite transceiver.
TELEM-COMMS-64H：For Wilkes Trough Ice Divide Station, autonomous telemetry link validation is not confirmed, as continuous test pings to the McMurdo base server over 48 hours via the high-gain polar satellite transceiver did not succeed.

information_points.title: Satellite uplink capacity（BANDW）
information_points.content:
TELEM-BANDW-TXC：The candidate surface ground station transceiver at Dome Charlie Traverse Camp demonstrates a peak data burst rate of 512 kbps during maximum sustained low-Earth-orbit telemetry operations.
TELEM-BANDW-OF0：The candidate surface ground station transceiver at Wilkes Trough Ice Divide Station demonstrates a peak data burst rate of 256 kbps during maximum sustained low-Earth-orbit telemetry operations.
TELEM-BANDW-1TD：The candidate surface ground station transceiver at Amundsen Ridge Nunatak Outpost demonstrates a peak data burst rate of 128 kbps during maximum sustained low-Earth-orbit telemetry operations.
